title: Review of SCDF Training in wake of Recent Passing of NSF Firefighter
what_it_is: Review of SCDF Training in wake of Recent Passing of NSF Firefighter

sections.label: Firefighter NSF deployment requirements
sections.summary: NSFs must be medically fit, meet PES A, B1 or B2, and complete Basic Rescue Training and a 12-week Firefighter Course.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: To be deployed as firefighters, full-time national servicemen (NSFs) need to be certified medically fit and of Physical Employment Standards (PES) "A", "B1" or "B2".

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: They will also need to complete a four-week Basic Rescue Training, as well as a 12-week Firefighter Course (FFC) at the Civil Defence Academy (CDA).

sections.label: Resources deployed to fatal fire
sections.summary: 22 emergency vehicles and 61 responders from six fire stations were deployed, and SGT1 Edward Go's death was SCDF's first firefighting fatality.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Based on the ground commander's assessment of the resources needed for the operation, 22 emergency vehicles and 61 responders from six fire stations were deployed to the incident.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The passing of SGT1 Edward Go is the first SCDF fatality in a firefighting operation.

sections.label: SGT1 Edward Go's firefighter training
sections.summary: SGT1 Edward Go attained Gold in IPPT, an A grading in BAPT, ranked in the top 25% of his cohort, and attended nearly 60 calls.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: During his training as a firefighter, SGT1 Edward Go attained the "Gold" standard for his Individual Physical Proficiency Test (IPPT) and fared well in the other mandatory course requirements, including achieving an "A" grading for his Breathing Apparatus Proficiency Test (BAPT).

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: His performance, in fact, was among the top 25% in his cohort.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In fact, when he was posted to the Central Fire Station in May 2022, he had attended to nearly 60 fire and rescue calls.

sections.label: HDB buildings and Fire Code compliance
sections.summary: All HDB buildings, not only rental flats, comply with the prevailing Fire Code at the time they were built or renovated.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Can the Minister of State share if there are any gaps in the design of our public rental housing blocks that might make them more prone to fire risk?

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Not only rental flats, all Housing and Development Board (HDB) buildings are compliant with the prevailing Fire Code at the time when they were built or renovated.

sections.label: Town Council fire safety inspections
sections.summary: Town Councils conduct fire safety inspections, and Block 91 Henderson Road complied with the Fire Code requirement on fire engine access road distance.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: On a day-to-day basis, the Town Council conducts fire safety inspections of the HDB blocks, such as checking on obstruction along corridors and requiring residents to remove them.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, the involved Block 91 Henderson Road also complied with the prevailing Fire Code requirements, that the fire engine access road must be within 18 metres of the dry riser breaching inlets located near the exit staircases.

sections.label: State Coroner's inquiry power
sections.summary: Under the Coroners Act 2010, the State Coroner may decide to hold a Coroner's inquiry to establish the circumstances leading to a death.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Yes, under the Coroners Act 2010, the State Coroner may decide to hold a Coroner's inquiry to establish the circumstances leading to a death.

sections.label: Assurance of thorough investigation
sections.summary: The speaker assures Members that a thorough and proper investigation will be conducted.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Nevertheless, I assure the Members that we are going to do a thorough and proper investigation.
